hero.title: rawb.start
hero.subtitle:
The game gives you a camera. I look for another one.
I capture scenes from the angle the game doesn't offer you, choose every camera move and framing, then turn them into a visual story.

about.title: About
about.introGaming: I'm a <hl>video editor</hl> and gaming is my thing: I cut highlights, trailers and Instagram content with one goal, keeping viewers watching from the first second. I work on <hl>rhythm</hl>, sound and the moments that make the difference, because a good clip doesn't just show the game: it tells it.
about.introBrand: I'm a <hl>video editor</hl> working with brands and creators to turn ideas and raw footage into clear, polished videos. I focus on <hl>social</hl> content and brand videos, with attention to visual consistency, pacing and message. My goal is for every video to sound like the brand behind it.

slim-dogs.description: Long-form and short-form editing for YouTube and social, focused on pacing and retention. For creators and brands like Gaming Dogs, Amazon Prime Video and San Carlo.

festa-del-cinema.description: Shot and edited masterclasses with Viggo Mortensen and Dennis Lehane, among others. Red carpet photography.

freelance.description: Reels, trailers and showreels for indie games for Cama's Game Slice. Event coverage for Rome Future Week and Roma3x3.
